notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content: [p]Highlights: [/p][p]- All the reamining stages have been updated with new graphics and better object placement! - Language options have been added! You can now play the game in Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean in addition to English. [/p][p]- Improved UI and cutscene scaling on different aspect ratios. [/p][p]- Improved loading times. [/p][p]- Removed the "number of objects to find" Free Play setting as most stages couldn't generate enough objects to justify it. Sorry! [/p][p][/p][p]Other stuff: [/p][p]- Various tweaks and adjustments to UI. [/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the same object could be found twice if you clicked fast enough. [/p][p]- Fixed several bugs related to stages not resetting properly. [/p][p]- Fixed the time bonus and penelties doing nothing if time limit wasn't also selected - the timer now defaults to 30 seconds per objects in that case.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.1:
notes.content:
- Achievements have been added!
- Added several new Mechanics to Free Play mode! You can now challenge the mode with the target list obscured or the map in grayscale. The "No Hints" mechanic should now be able to be selected as well.
- Reworked the Entrance Hall with many new Hidden Objects, backgrounds etc.
- Improved Hidden Object number and variety in the Kitchen. Should no longer spawn with only 6-7 Hidden Objects.
- Also made some tweaks to spawns other stages, to reduce instances of objects spawning behind other objects etc.
- Added credits to the main menu.
- Hint markers should now point at the center of the Hidden Object instead of its base.
- Fixed "items found/total" text displaying strange values in instances where more targets were expected than there were items on the stage.
- The clock in timed stages should now actually display the remaining time.
﻿
